description: A small clear plastic food container with gray side latches sits on a green-covered table, with a yellow piece of food inside. The left hand and right hand come in to grasp the container as a two-hand object, the right hand flips the latch and lifts the lid open, then the right hand reaches in, removes the yellow piece, and sets it down to the right while the left hand steadies the open container as a left-hand object.
